Play Dinkum – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/dinkum-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

A new life awaits in Dinkum, a survival life sim filled with endless possibilities! Grab your tools, gather resources, and grow your town—solo or with friends. Create your dream farm by planting crops and raising animals, with changing seasons and weather affecting your crops so every day brings a new challenge. Or slip on your flip-flops and roam the island hunting for rare fish, bugs, and ores at your own pace!
